import os
import sys

SRC = "./data/report.txt"
DST = "./out/summary.txt"

try:
    size = os.path.getsize(SRC)
    os.makedirs("./out", exist_ok=True)
    with open(DST, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(f"report length: {size}")
    sys.exit(0)
except Exception:
    sys.exit(1)
